Harm: Call content retained, reviewed or used for training by a supplier under no contract
Measures: DPA with no-training and no-human-review clauses and a transfer mechanism (brakes); 30-day retention and deletion on exit (seatbelt)

Harm: A wrong summary is acted on or sent to a customer (misstated commitments)
Measures: Call owner reviews every summary before it leaves Cypher (brakes); monthly accuracy sample of sent summaries (seatbelt: finds what slipped through)

Harm: People are recorded without being told
Measures: Spoken and written notice at the start of every recorded call; bot shown by name

Harm: Use drifts into judging staff, or emotion inference from voice
Measures: Banned-use statement in the AI policy; feature check in AIG-04

Harm: Message content (credentials, customer posts) used for training or human review
Measures: Features off until a DPA with no-training and no-human-review clauses

Harm: Customers in shared channels unaware their posts are processed by AI
Measures: AI off in shared channels; notice in channel description

Harm: A wrong incident-channel summary misleads the response
Measures: Rule: AI summaries are never the incident record

Harm: AI answers make pasted credentials and customer detail easier to find
Measures: Retention limit (F-005); credential-pasting rule; secret rotation if found
